mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 68 degree temperatures, partly cloudy skies at City Hall, and an air quality index of 52. We are in a first quarter moon phase, and you can spot the ISS tonight starting at 3:23 AM as it travels from Belleville toward Fitchburg. Tonight's low will be 63 degrees with rain expected.

The city is currently recruiting for an Engineering Technician to oversee municipal construction projects through September 20. Additionally, the Council recently approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates to cover essential system maintenance and prevent future service failures.

We have a great lineup for you. Today, we have the User Group Meeting at Epic, Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by the Farmers Market this Saturday.

During the week, officers responded to a noteworthy incident on Friday, August 15, involving a 44-year-old woman who was arrested for a first offence O W I after being found unresponsive behind the wheel.

Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Heath Crunch. Please note that the store is closing in less than one hour, so you have just enough time to head over for a scoop before they lock up for the night.
